transcript.text: Hi everyone, thanks for being on the call today. As you know, we need to get Grandma's prescription picked up and a package mailed, and I'd like to handle both in one outing since the pharmacy and post office are in the same shopping area. Before I finalize the plan, I want to go around the group and hear what each of you thinks we should consider. Who wants to start?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I should mention that I can drive and accompany Grandma, but only on Wednesday from 09:30 to 12:00 — that's the only window I have due to my work schedule.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I spoke with Grandma's occupational therapist recently, and they recommended limiting her standing and walking to exactly 45 minutes. They also suggested using pharmacy curbside pickup rather than having her wait inside. I haven't had a chance to share this with everyone yet, so I wanted to make sure it's on the table before we finalize the plan.
transcript.speaker: A3

commitments.detail: Daniel will drive Grandma to the shopping area on Wednesday at 09:30 to pick up her prescription via curbside pickup and mail a package at the post office, completing both errands within the 45-minute standing/walking limit recommended by the occupational therapist.
